summary: Australian (+61) clothing-brand owner who reached out about recovering two disabled Instagram business accounts: @avaliactivewear (~25k followers, activewear) and @lilithcavalieremerch (~20k followers, merch). Both received Meta 'permanently disabled' emails in mid-June 2026, and a photo-ID appeal on @avaliactivewear was rejected; screenshots show login succeeding but the profile empty with settings errors. They balked at the initial quote as a small brand and asked for a lower price; the deal never closed. On 2026-08-04 follow-up they said the accounts are deactivated and it's 'not worth the money' getting them back — conversation ended cordially, so they're a warm but currently closed lead.
